title: Audit & remediation: focus scopes, semantic role harmonization, and VPAT annex for dense list widgets
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Scope: This ticket covers an end-to-end audit and targeted remediation for dense list and compact table widgets (rows, row-actions, inline controls) plus a small VPAT annex describing the changes and test artifacts. The focus areas are: (1) clearly defined focus scopes to avoid tab-trap and invisible focus in high-density lists, (2) semantic role harmonization across list/table components so assistive tech reads concise and consistent labels, (3) contrast adjustments for token-driven interactive states (hover/focus/disabled), and (4) updated keyboard navigation patterns for nested inline controls (menus, toggles, row-action buttons). Deliverables: updated component guidelines in the Design System, a patch set of component tokens and styles, updated ARIA attributes in markup examples, a short VPAT annex with tested scenarios, and a QA checklist that Eng and QA can run during rollout.
acceptance_criteria:
- Focus scopes implemented for DenseList and CompactTable so Tab and Shift+Tab are predictable and do not skip interactive children.
- ARIA roles and labels standardized: listitems, rowgroups, rowheaders, and contextual button labels validated with VoiceOver and NVDA.
- Contrast delta for focus/hover states follows revised contrast ramp (measured against tokens) and passes automated contrast tests.
- Keyboard patterns for nested controls implemented: Enter to activate, Space/Arrow keys semantics preserved, Escape to close transient overlays.
- VPAT annex created with test scenarios, screenshots, and references to the updated component examples.
- At least two engineering PRs and one design review sign-off recorded; visual regression and accessibility smoke tests pass on CI.
tasks: Audit: run axe-ci and internal tab-order tooling against pages that use DenseList/CompactTable (dashboard, activity log, dataset table)
Design: update focus-ring spec and compact-state color ramp in tokens figma page
Doc: add semantic role matrix and example snippets to component docs page
Eng: implement focus-scope utility and update DenseList/CompactTable components (PRs: #1234, #1240)
QA: create VPAT annex test-cases and run cross-platform checks (NVDA/Firefox, VoiceOver/Safari)
Release: coordinate rollout with console team and add toggle-based gradual rollout for 2 weeks
